title: LIVORA
description:
WHAT KIND OF LIFE WILL YOUR DECISIONS CREATE?LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation about building a life while everything competes for your attention.

Work. Money. Relationships. Health. Family. Time. Ambition.

Plan your days, build a career, manage your finances, form relationships, travel, buy assets, start a family and deal with whatever life throws at you.

Every choice takes you somewhere.

Spend too much and money becomes a problem. Put work first and your relationships may suffer. Ignore your health and it can catch up with you. Make time for the people around you and those relationships can become something much bigger.

There is rarely one perfect answer.

There is only the life your decisions create.

YOUR LIFE REMEMBERSLIVORA is built around consequences that do not always happen immediately.

A decision today can matter days, months or even years later.

People remember how you treated them. Problems you ignored can return. Financial decisions build on each other. Relationships change. Career choices can create new opportunities while closing others.

Something that seemed unimportant at the time can become one of the defining moments of your Life.

Your story is not a collection of isolated choices.

It is one connected Life.

PLAN YOUR DAYSTime matters.

Your days are filled with responsibilities, opportunities and people competing for the hours you have available.

Choose where to go, what to do and who to spend your time with. Head out for food, exercise, shopping, entertainment and social plans, or use your time to focus on yourself and the things that matter most.

Weekends and evenings open up different possibilities, from nights out and social events to quieter plans closer to home.

Sometimes you can plan an entire free day across the morning, afternoon and evening.

But plans interact.

An expensive afternoon might change what you can afford that night. Sleeping in could restore your energy but cost you valuable time. A great day might even lead somewhere you never expected.

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS, A FAMILY AND A SOCIAL LIFEThe people in your Life are more than numbers on a screen.

Friendships can deepen or drift apart. New people can enter your Life through work, events and everyday situations. Messages and Group Chats keep conversations moving even when you are somewhere else.

Romantic relationships can develop through dates, conversations and shared experiences.

As things become more serious, you may face bigger decisions around commitment, living together, marriage and family.

People have their own needs, expectations and problems. Difficult conversations happen. Promises can be broken. Relationships can grow stronger, change direction or come to an end.

How you treat people matters — and they may remember it long after the moment has passed.

BUILD A CAREER, MANAGE MONEY AND CREATE A FUTUREWork can provide stability, opportunity and a route towards a better Life, but it comes with trade-offs.

Search for jobs, apply for opportunities, attend interviews and develop your career over time. Qualifications, experience and circumstances can all affect which paths are genuinely available to you.

Better jobs can mean more money, but work also takes time and energy away from everything else.

And then there is the money itself.

Income arrives. Bills need paying. Everyday spending adds up. Unexpected costs appear when you could really do without them.

Save for the future or enjoy the money now. Take the cheaper option or pay for convenience. Help somebody else or protect your own finances.

As your Life develops, you can build beyond everyday income through property, businesses, investments and other assets.

Building wealth is possible.

Keeping the rest of your Life together while doing it is the difficult part.

LIVE THE MOMENTS BETWEEN THE BIG DECISIONSLife is not only work, bills and major milestones.

Go out with friends. Spend time with family. Eat somewhere new. Exercise. Shop. Relax. Take a short break or head away on holiday.

Events can build up over time, giving you something to prepare for and look forward to. You can also organise plans of your own and decide who you want there.

Some moments will change the direction of your Life.

Others will simply become great memories.

And sometimes the best stories come from days that went completely off-plan.

A WORLD THAT KEEPS MOVINGYour Life does not exist in isolation.

Weather, changing circumstances and wider events can affect what happens around you.

Plans change. Costs change. Opportunities appear. Unexpected situations can force you to rethink what you were going to do.

You can plan carefully, make sensible decisions and try to stay in control.

But you cannot control everything.

Sometimes Life simply happens.

NO TWO LIVES NEED TO BE THE SAMEMoney affects where you can live.

Work affects your money and time.

Time affects your relationships.

Relationships affect your choices.

Health affects what you can do.

Family creates new priorities.

Everything connects.

You might make the sensible financial choice and regret what it cost you personally. Sacrifice an opportunity for somebody you care about. Take a risk that changes everything that follows.

And when one Life ends, you can start again.

Choose different priorities. Follow another career. Build different relationships. Spend differently. Take more risks. Play it safe.

One changed decision can send an entire Life in another direction.

You may build exactly the Life you wanted.

You may end up somewhere completely unexpected.

Or you may finish already thinking about what you would do differently next time.

BUILD A LIFE. LIVE WITH WHAT FOLLOWS.Your money.

Your career.

Your relationships.

Your family.

Your health.

Your time.

Your opportunities.

Your mistakes.

Your Life.

What happens next is up to you.
description_short: Build a life and live with what follows. LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation where money, work, relationships, health, family and time collide. Plan your days, chase opportunities and face consequences that can return days, months or years later.
